resources.string: No sessions available. Open a session on your PC, then refresh.
Queues a text follow-up on your running PC.
Disconnected or unavailable. Reconnect before sending; nothing is queued offline.
Waiting for the PC inbox acknowledgement.
This session is closed. Select another existing session.
Check the original session before clearing this warning.
Select an existing session to send a follow-up.
Delivery unknown. The PC may have admitted this work. Check the original session before sending again. Nothing is resent automatically.
Accepted into the PC’s in-memory inbox, not durable storage or completed work.
Have you checked the original session?

The PC may have accepted the previous text even if its acknowledgement was lost. Clear only this warning after checking. This does not resend, cancel, or erase admitted work. Your next Send is a new submission.
Could not read the session. Previous text is still shown. Try Refresh.
Not sent. Your draft is retained. Try again when connected.
This PC is already paired. Cancel, then forget its pairing before linking it again.
Could not link this PC. Create a fresh invitation and try again.
Use the complete, unexpired harnessy://pair# invitation from your PC.
Pairing needs repair. Forget it and link the PC again. No replacement key was created.
Storage could not be confirmed. Sending is blocked; the phone key is retained. Forget the pairing to repair it.
Saved pairing or delivery warning is invalid. Check the PC for admitted work, then reset this app’s data in Android settings and pair again.
Removal could not be confirmed. The phone key is retained and sending stays blocked. Try Forget again.
Disconnected. Reconnecting while this app stays in the foreground. Your PC may be asleep.
Create an invitation in Harnessy on your PC, then paste it here. Sessions, agents, and storage stay on that PC. Opening a link does not approve pairing.
Paste the invitation from your PC
Linking. Compare the full phone fingerprint on your PC before approving.
Phone public-key SHA-256 fingerprint. Compare all 64 lowercase characters with the PC’s pairing dialog:

Keep the PC awake. Leaving this app disconnects the phone and discards invitations. No offline queue or push notifications. Only existing sessions and text follow-ups are supported; attachments, new sessions, and remote approval answers are unavailable.

Remove this phone’s local pairing and signing key for %1$s. This does not revoke the PC grant or erase work already admitted. Check uncertain deliveries first. Remove the phone in Harnessy on your PC to revoke access.
